paper.title: Little Red Dots: Rapidly Growing Black Holes Reddened by Extended Dusty Flows

result.summary: 本文针对 JWST 发现的 little red dots（LRD）的 V 形光谱特征，提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 SED 模型：AGN 的典型辐射被嵌入在具有类似猎户座星云消光律的延展尘埃介质中 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。模型用尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射解释 λ>4000 Å 的红色光学连续谱和 λ<3000 Å 的平坦紫外谱，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S5.p2]。在红外波段，延展的尘埃气体分布（γ<1）使较冷尘埃主导辐射，将能量峰从近红外移到中红外，从而产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的平坦红外 SED [S5.p2]。作者据此提出 LRD 可能源于星系核早期组装阶段快速生长的黑洞 [S4.SS5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的是 LRD 的 V 形光谱特征（红色光学连续谱加紫外过剩）的来源问题，即如何辨别星系与 AGN 的相对贡献 [S5.p1]。作者指出，尽管光谱观测已确认 LRD 中存在宽发射线成分和 AGN，但 JWST/NIRCam 观测到的这一特征仍挑战着人们对 LRD 起源的理解 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: the characteristic v-shape spectral feature observed through JWST/NIRCam challenges us to understand the origin of these LRDs and the contribution from AGNs powered by accreting BHs.
Spectroscopic observations have confirmed the broad components of emission lines and the presence of AGNs within LRDs.

method.text: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD 光谱能量分布（SED）模型，假设 AGN 的典型辐射被嵌入在延展尘埃介质中，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，在 λ>4000 Å 呈红色光学连续谱，在 λ<3000 Å 通过灰消光曲线形成平坦紫外谱，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S5.p2]。红外部分由径向密度分布为 ρ=ρ0(r/rin)^(-γ) 的延展尘埃气体塑造，通过辐射加热与热发射冷却的平衡确定尘埃温度 [S3.p3]。

evidence.quote: We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.

The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$
In this scenario, there is no need for additional stellar emission or AGN scattered light.
we focus not only on a compact dust structure such as a dust torus, but rather a more extended dust structure described by a radial density profile of $\rho=\rho_{0}(r/r_{\rm in})^{-\gamma}$

experiments.text: 论文通过改变尘埃气体密度和径向分布参数来检验模型 SED 形状：在固定 γ=0 时，比较了升华半径处气体密度 1≤n0/cm^-3≤10^3 范围内的 SED 变化 [S3.p7]。结果显示，当 n0=10^3 cm^-3 时，遮蔽物质外缘位于 rout≳30 rin，尘埃温度从约 1500 K 到约 200 K，再处理红外谱从 λ≃1 μm 开始上升并呈现覆盖 λ≃2-15 μm 的近-中红外峰 [S3.p7]。作者将该模型输出与 JWST MIRI 对 LRD 的光度数据进行比较 [S3.p7]。

evidence.quote: we show the dependence of the SED shape on the gas density ( $1\leq n_{0}/{\rm cm}^{-3}\leq 10^{3}$) at the sublimation radius, while the slope of its radial profile is fixed to $\gamma=0$.

When the density is as high as $n_{0}=10^{3}~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the outer edge of the obscuring material is located at $r_{\rm out}\gtrsim 30~r_{\rm in}$, where the dust temperature ranges from $T_{\rm dust}\simeq 1500~{\rm K}$ to $\sim 200~{\rm K}$.
the reprocessed IR spectrum begins to rise from $\lambda\simeq 1~\mu{\rm m}$ and exhibits a near- to mid-infrared bump that covers $\lambda\simeq 2-15~\mu{\rm m}$.
this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.

findings.text: 模型表明，当尘埃气体密度过高（n0≳10^3 cm^-3）时，热尘埃产生的明亮近红外峰会形成从约 6000 Å 到约 2 μm 的极红 SED，这与 JWST MIRI 对 LRD 的观测不符 [S3.p7]。相反，延展的尘埃气体分布（γ<1）使较冷尘埃主导辐射，将能量峰从近红外移到中红外，从而产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的平坦红外 SED [S5.p2]。作者据此提出 LRD 源于嵌入在延展尘埃流中的快速生长黑洞 [S4.SS5.p1]。此外，若准确修正尘埃消光，在 AV=3 时 Eddington 比可提高约 2.6 倍，使部分 LRD 的黑洞 Eddington 比接近 1，提示相当一部分 LRD 可能是超 Eddington 吸积体 [S4.SS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: the bright NIR bump makes the SED shape substantially redder from $\lambda\simeq 6000~{\rm\AA}$ to $\sim 2~\mu{\rm m}$, consistently observed in AGNs with hot dust tori.
this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.
This model, unlike the typical AGN hot torus models, can produce a infrared SED flattening that is consistent with LRD observations through JWST MIRI.
we propose that LRDs originate from rapidly growing BH embedded within dusty flows with an extended density distribution.
by applying a dust correction, the Eddington ratio increases by a factor of $\mathscr{L}\sim 10^{0.14A_{\rm V}}\sim 2.6$ for $A_{\rm V}=3$.
With this correction, the Eddington ratios of BHs reported by approach unity, suggesting that a significant fraction of LRDs may be super-Eddington accretors.

limitations.text: 作者指出，关于延展尘埃介质中多尺度散射导致 AGN 变异性被抑制的情景，其更详细的定量分析将在未来工作中探讨 [S4.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.
